newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas workers split $54 million.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas workers split $54 million.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp said Friday more than 45,000 non-executive employees from its military, commercial and transport aircraft business units received monetary awards totaling $54 million.

The company said the awards recognize the employees' contributions to its record performance in 1996. About $47 million was distributed through an Employee Performance Incentive Plan that will continue in 1997, the company said.
McDonnell Douglas said nearly 8,000 United Aerospace Workers union members will split a bonus of almost $7 million.
McDonnell Douglas is he nation's largest producer of military aircraft and the third-largest commercial aircraft manufacturing company.
Its shares closed up 1-3/4 Friday at 68-1/8.
